# Package `cmp`

```go
package cmp
```

Package cmp provides types and functions related to comparing ordered values.

## Index

- [func Compare](#func-compare)
- [func Less](#func-less)
- [func Or](#func-or)
- [type Ordered](#type-ordered)

## Functions

### func Compare

```go
func Compare[T Ordered](x, y T) int
```

Compare returns -1, 0, or 1 when x is less than, equal to, or greater than y. Floating-point NaN values are considered less than any non-NaN value and equal to each other.

### func Less

```go
func Less[T Ordered](x, y T) bool
```

Less reports whether x is less than y. Floating-point NaN values are considered less than any non-NaN value and equal to each other.

### func Or

```go
func Or[T comparable](values ...T) T
```

Or returns the first of its arguments that is not equal to the zero value. If no argument is non-zero, Or returns the zero value.

## Types

### type Ordered

```go
type Ordered interface { ... }
```

Ordered is a constraint that permits any ordered type: any type that supports the operators \< \<= >= >.
